{{Quote|Hey! You're a commando! Thank goodness!''"<br />"''What happened here?''"<br />"''I'm not sure. I was, uh, scanning the maintenance corridors when I heard blaster fire. By the time I got to where the noise was, everyone was dead.|The clone trooper greets Boss|<ref name="SWRC" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was stationed aboard the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'', which was [[Attack on the Prosecutor|captured]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], and survived the initial attack by hiding within the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] bays. He came out of hiding when the ''Prosecutor'' reappeared in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] and was subsequently [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|boarded]] by the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]]. However, upon opening a maintenance hatch for Republic [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droid]] belonging to the slavers.

==Biography==
{{Quote|What a waste of good genes.|Boss, lamenting the clone trooper's death|<ref name="SWRC" />}}
[[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Enc" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SWRC" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was stationed aboard the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'' when the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Attack on the Prosecutor|attacked]] and boarded by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] whilst patrolling [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. The clone trooper survived the attack by making his way to the ship's [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] bays until the ''Prosecutor'' reappeared in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]], part of the [[Chaykin Cluster]]. When the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the Republic's [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] were [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|dispatched]] to the ''Prosecutor'', the clone trooper was the first [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] encountered by the [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] leader, [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]]. The clone trooper expressed his relief upon seeing the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] and, when Boss asked him what had happened aboard the ''Prosecutor'', remarked that he had been surveying the ship's maintenance corridors at the [[Time/Legends|time]] it was attacked.<ref name="SWRC" />

Boss accused the clone trooper of cowardice, but the trooper claimed that he had gone to the torpedo bay so that he could launch a torpedo in order to alert the Republic of the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} status. While thanking Boss for rescuing him, the trooper used a [[Computer/Legends|console]] to open a maintenance hatch for the commando. However, doing so distracted the trooper from noticing a nearby [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droid]] used by the slavers. Unable to help him otherwise, Boss tried to warn the trooper of this threat but to no avail, as the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attacked the trooper, causing him to fall into a nearby pit. The droid then dragged the trooper's [[Death/Legends|lifeless]] body upward and deposited it where he had been initially standing.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|So you came to the torpedo bay to hide.''"<br />"''No sir! I was going to try to, uh, launch a torpedo, and alert the Republic! But you're here now, so no need for that, eh? Thanks for the resc-ACK!|The clone trooper tries to explain his cowardice to Boss before meeting his demise|<ref name="SWRC" />}}
Like all clones of Jango Fett,<ref name="DB" /> the clone trooper stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height<ref name="Enc" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> He survived the Trandoshan attack on the ''Prosecutor'' by hiding in the ship's torpedo bays. Although the trooper claimed to be trying to send a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]], Boss was of the opinion that the trooper hid because he was a coward.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Equipment==
The clone wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="SWRC" /><ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and was armed with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]<ref name="SWRC" /><ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> aboard the ''Prosecutor''.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Behind the scenes==
This clone trooper first appeared in [[LucasArts]]' first-person shooter [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'',<ref name="SWRC" /> which was released in [[2005]].<ref name="Amazon">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2022|Sith Unseen: A Retrospective}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Roger Jackson]]<ref name="SWRC" /> and was briefly mentioned in the game's [[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide|official strategy guide]].<ref name="RCPG">[[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Republic Commando'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
